title: Bustier and Corset Masterclass
description: Learn to build a corset that holds its shape and fits like a second skin. Over three weeks you will draft your own bodice block, cut clean princess darts, cage the bust for support, and finish every seam like a professional. This is the class for anyone ready to stop guessing and start constructing with real skill.
summary: Two-part corsets, princess dart bustiers, deep plunge necklines, bust caging, yoke draping and simple beading finishing.

title: Blazer Class
description: A blazer is the one piece that makes an outfit look complete. In this class you will take accurate measurements, cut a jacket from scratch, and sew collars, lapels and a full waistcoat with confidence. By the end you will own a skill that clients are happy to pay well for.
summary: Accurate blazer measurement, drafting and cutting from scratch, notched and shawl collars, waistcoats, and professional finishing techniques.

title: A to Z Pant Masterclass
description: Pants are one of the most requested pieces in any wardrobe. This class takes you from beginning to end through straight pants, palazzo, shorts, joggers and cargo styles. You will learn to take an accurate crotch measurement, the detail most people get wrong, plus you receive a free jumpsuit tutorial as a bonus.
summary: Straight pants, palazzo, shorts, joggers and cargo pants, plus accurate crotch measurement for a perfect fit. Bonus: free jumpsuit tutorial.

title: Online Beading Class
description: Beading turns a simple garment into something people stop and stare at. In this class you will learn beading materials and several beading patterns, including random, clustered and twisted styles, plus how to use a rivet machine like a pro. Perfect for anyone who wants to add a signature finish to their work.
summary: Beading materials, random, clustered, straight-line and twisted beading, ombre effects, dress-tip beading, and rivet machine technique.

title: Butt and Hip Pad Class
description: This foundation class teaches you to build a butt and hip pad that looks natural and sits right every time. You will learn accurate measurement, how to identify the correct foam type, and how to draft, cut and sew a clean, professional pad from start to finish.
summary: Accurate padding measurement, foam type identification, and pattern drafting, cutting and sewing of a perfectly shaped butt and hip pad.
